title: Cosmopsychism does not face the combination problem

statements.text: Cosmopsychism denies that ordinary experiences are constituted by the phenomenal properties of physical ultimates, so it does not face the combination problem. A perfectly smooth painting cannot be an aggregate of dots, but it can be a segment of a larger painting that is equally smooth, as a smooth ordinary experience can be a segment of a smooth cosmic consciousness.

sources.quote: Priority cosmopsychism, however, does not face the combination problem
Such a painting cannot be an aggregate of small dots
